content: NVIDIA documents runtime capability queries through NvEncGetEncodeCaps and shows HEVC 4:4:4 support on Ampere/Ada while AV1 uses Main profile 4:2:0 on Ada. Apple exposes VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported by codec, but profile/chroma and actual decoder selection require creating and exercising a VTDecompressionSession with representative format data; therefore tuple-level probes and first-frame verification are required rather than model-name assumptions.
